official_description:
The Roland TD-02KV electronic drum kit is designed to provide an authentic drumming experience with Roland's acclaimed mesh-head pads and dynamic sensing technology. Its compact design makes it ideal for home practice, small spaces, and easy storage. The advanced TD-02 sound module features a wide range of expressive drum kits and built-in coaching functions to help drummers of all levels develop their skills.

This kit includes a snare drum with a mesh head, three tom pads, crash and ride cymbals, a hi-hat, and a kick drum. The TD-02 module provides access to a variety of drum sounds and training tools. The responsive mesh heads offer realistic feel, and the adjustable sensitivity allows you to customize the kit to your playing style. Integrated Bluetooth connectivity enables wireless streaming of music from your smartphone or tablet, making practice sessions more engaging and fun.
